description: Source code for the trp_information_exchange_procedure class, implementing TRP information exchange logic including request handling, response creation, and PDU communication within a 3GPP-related system.

classes.name: trp_information_exchange_procedure
classes.description: Handles the exchange of TRP information, including request processing, response generation, and communication with CU-CP.

methods.name: operator()

methods.name: send_ul_nrppa_pdu
methods.description: Packages and sends the PDU to CU-CP, with logging.

methods.name: create_trp_info_failure

methods.name: create_trp_info_response
methods.description: Creates a success response PDU with TRP info responses.
